text:
Maya R: Quick ask 00 flying into Rotterdam but we have a half-day offsite in Gouda at 11:30. Any good lunch spots near the Markt that are dairy-free friendly? A teammate is lactose-intolerant.
Theo: Kaashuis Tromp is iconic but yeah that's cheese-central (not great for dairy-free).
Lina: Theres a tiny place called Brood & Spijs that does hearty sandwiches and has a labeled dairy-free menu. Opens 09:00.
owen-ops: Also check Falafel King on Hoge Gouwe  their wraps are reliably dairy-free and quick if you're on a tight schedule. :falafel:  
Maya R: Perfect. Anything sit-down with a view of the Markt? Prefer outdoor seating if weather's decent.
Lina: De Markt Cafe has outdoor tables and a few vegan options but it can be slow. If you want quick + view, Brood & Spijs terrace is small but faces the canal.
nina-cust: FYI: the Gouda cheese market is only on Thursdays in summer; if youre there then, it gets crowded. Plan extra time.
Maya R: Good call. Travel time from Rotterdam Centraal? Trying to sync trains.
Theo: Typical: 30-45 min regional train + 10 min walk. Here's a sample route:
```
Rotterdam Centraal -> Sprinter to Gouda (approx 28m)
Walk from Gouda station to Markt ~10m (straight down Korte Tiendeweg)
```
Lina: If youre booking for 12 people, call Brood & Spijs  they accept group bookings but ask about dairy-free options in advance.
Maya R: Quick poll: react with :seat: for sit-down (De Markt/De Brood & Spijs) or :togo: for takeaway (Falafel King/market stalls).
owen-ops: :togo: (tight schedule)
Lina: :seat: (want to hear updates after the session)
Maya R: Poll leaning takeaway but I'll call Brood & Spijs to confirm dairy-free menu just in case. Thanks all!
travel-bot: Reminder set: depart Rotterdam Centraal 09:45 for Gouda to arrive before 11:30. Have a great offsite!
